description:
For up to 50 keywords, count how many TLDs each exact name is registered in (keyword.tld), among the TLDs DomainKits tracks, split into popular TLDs, country-code TLDs, and other gTLDs. Returns counts only: it does not list individual TLDs, check availability, or report sale status.

Related: tld_check (per-TLD status for one keyword), bulk_available (status of specific domains).
name: bulk_tld

cctld.description: Count in country-code TLDs outside the popular set

other.description: Count in other gTLDs outside the popular set

popular.description: Count in popular TLDs (com, net, org, io, ai, app, and similar; io and ai count here, not in cctld)

total.description: Number of TLDs where keyword.tld is registered (popular + cctld + other)

title: Keyword TLD Popularity Check
